title: Mouse pointer frozen
symptom: Mouse pointer does not move, keyboard works
user_description: My mouse pointer is stuck in the middle of the screen. I can type, but I can't click on anything.

options.why: Completely out of proportion. The PC is clearly working because the keyboard responds.

options.text: Check the mouse cable or batteries, try another USB port, and test on a different surface
options.why: A frozen pointer with a working keyboard usually means a loose cable, flat batteries, a dirty sensor or a bad surface. These checks are quick and cost nothing.
Unrelated and risky. A BIOS update is never the first step for a mouse that will not move.

options.text: Tell the user to use only the keyboard from now on
options.why: This leaves the problem unfixed and slows the user down. Support exists to fix the cause.

hints: Does the keyboard still work? What does that tell you about the PC?
What does the mouse need to work: a cable, a receiver or batteries?
real_world_tip: Press the mouse's small connect button or re-seat the wireless receiver. Many wireless mouse problems are just a lost connection.
